notes.text:
Chronological Violation of Saṃjñā Assignment (Engine Defect)
Step: #71
Sūtra involved: 1.1.43 सुडनपुंसकस्य.
Issue: The engine applies 1.1.43 to assign the sarvanāmasthāna designation to the suffix sya after the primary substitution (7.1.12) has already taken place in step #65.
First, saṃjñā declarations must occur immediately to establish the linguistic state before operational rules (vidhi) execute.
Second, 1.1.43 only applies to the first five affixes (su, au, jas, am, auṭ). The Genitive singular ṅas (or its substitute sya) is categorically excluded from being a sarvanāmasthāna.
Classification: Engine defect (Major). The engine's conditional logic (cond()) for 1.1.43 is fundamentally broken if it evaluates to True for a Genitive affix.
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-16 — Right on the second point: 1.1.43 (suṭ = su, au, jas, am, auṭ) tagged sya (ṅas) because the condition was 'first varṇa is s'. Fixed: it now reads the original upadeśa (su / s~), not the letter on the tape. First point (timing) is the same S179 family: saṃjñās are tagged when the loop first sees their nimitta.
